example.title: The Ritz-Carlton, Laguna Niguel, 1 Ritz Carlton Drive

brief: A 1984 Mediterranean-style clifftop hotel: a long four-storey slab of pale cream stucco set along the bluff edge above Salt Creek Beach, the top floor lit by round-arched windows under shallow red-tile hip roofs, a glazed pavilion bay and projecting end wings, iron balconies on the sea front, and a lawn terrace lined with Adirondack chairs and palms running to the bluff. Coastal sage scrub on the slope below. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
